title: Replace with a plain title
hook: One or two precise sentences that state why the idea is worth a minute.
body:
Explain the idea itself in two short paragraphs, separated by a blank line. The card should teach the mechanism, not tease it. Name the assumption that does the work.

Add the caveat a careful reader would ask for. Prefer a well-established result over a clever obscurity.
deeper: A longer note: where the idea came from, what it does not say, and the usual way it gets overstated. Keep the tone curious and concrete.
example: A worked example with every number shown, or a specific historical case told carefully enough that a reader could check it.
